# git-identity - the git-identity plugin

::: v-pre

Bind a project to a GitHub account and a git commit identity. Every gh call and every commit in it then uses the right one - carried by the environment, not by a prompt a subagent can miss.

## Skills

### `/git-identity:profile-add` {#profile-add}

`/git-identity:profile-add <profile-name>`

Started by: you only. Claude does not start it on its own.

Create a git-identity profile - a named pairing of a GitHub account and a git commit identity. Run once per account, then bind projects to it with /git-identity:use.

### `/git-identity:status` {#status}

`/git-identity:status`

Started by: you only. Claude does not start it on its own.

Show which GitHub account and git identity this project is actually using right now, and whether that matches what it is bound to.

### `/git-identity:use` {#use}

`/git-identity:use <profile-name>`

Started by: you only. Claude does not start it on its own.

Bind the current project to a git-identity profile, so every gh call and every commit in it uses that GitHub account and identity.

## Hooks

### SessionStart {#session-start}

Event: `SessionStart` · Timeout: 5 s

SessionStart hook: report which git-identity profile this project is bound to.

Runs: `command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start.mjs" || true`

:::
